propositions: During execution-phase re-review, a Pass-1 finder flags plan-vs-code discrepancies where the code change fulfills the plan's directed end state, but the re-review incorrectly treats this as a false positive blocking correct ticket closure.

A new Pass-2 on-target veto must drop findings only when execution_review=True AND current_state_satisfies_plan_goal=yes AND the finding's criteria belong to the CODEBASE_GROUNDED cohort (E4, G1G2, A1, G6, asserted-capability).
The current_state_satisfies_plan_goal sub-answer is plan-review-only, defaults to na, does not participate in validity arithmetic, and is absent from base and code-review models.
The execution_review flag must flow from orchestrator.pass3_over_findings into the kernel-level pass3_decide call; the kwarg defaults to False so planning reviews and code-review paths are unchanged.

Cohort restriction is enforced deterministically in orchestrator via _restrict_on_target_veto_to_grounded, forcing non-grounded findings to na before kernel delegation, preventing single-turn toolless verifiers from firing the veto.

The veto reason is reason=veto:plan-goal-satisfied and applies only to code-grounded findings at execution time with a definite yes answer; no, insufficient, na, or absent answers do not trigger the veto.
